semanticBoundary.valueRoot: sha256 over dtype shape and canonical BF16 bits
semanticBoundary.providerRole: auxiliary OpenCL cl_mem lifetime and kernel execution organ only
semanticBoundary.residentAccess: read-only Tensor values bound to one persistent provider session
semanticBoundary.inputTransfer: host-to-device on first valueRoot bind; elided on exact identity/valueRoot hit
semanticBoundary.outputTransfer: explicit device-to-host readback for every matmul

residency.identityRule: same storageIdentity and same valueRoot may hit; changed valueRoot requires explicit replacement
residency.cleanup: release every resident cl_mem before context teardown

acceptance: RCL computes and binds a deterministic valueRoot from dtype, shape and canonical BF16 bits
first bind uploads exactly once and repeated exact identity/valueRoot binds report transfer elision
matmul consumes resident references without input bits and preserves exact output bits and execution roots
changed valueRoot without explicit replacement fails closed
resident counts and bytes stay within bounds and close releases every resident allocation
output readback remains explicit for every operation
